tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List devices paired with this Mac (one owner per device) with viewport, reachability, active revision, history, and any pending pairing. No secrets.

tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Get one paired device and, by default, probe it over the TLS 1.3 LAN link for reachability and active revision. Unpaired or unknown IDs return not_paired.

tools.name: discover_services
tools.description: List known _screenpunk._tcp advertisements and manually entered hosts. Optional host and port remember a manual device. Not unrestricted subnet scanning.

tools.name: request_pairing
tools.description: Start SAS pairing with an advertised or manual device over TLS 1.3 and return the six-digit matching code to show the user. The device shows its own code; the user must compare them and tap Confirm on the device. Never self-approves.

tools.name: confirm_pairing
tools.description: Complete pairing after the user confirmed the matching code on the device. Returns permission_required until the device owner has tapped Confirm there; the agent cannot approve on the device's behalf.

tools.name: forget_device
tools.description: Forget a device on this Mac only. This does not erase the device; its owner must hold two fingers for five seconds to open the device menu, then choose Disconnect and confirm on the device.

tools.name: propose_connection
tools.description: Propose a new or expanded connection. Returns pending or permission_required. Never self-approves.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List local dashboards and their draft/head revisions.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get a dashboard revision, manifest, and file inventory. No credentials.

tools.name: update_dashboard
tools.description: Create or update a dashboard. Optimistic baseRevision required after the first revision. Writes a new immutable revision.

tools.name: validate_dashboard
tools.description: Validate a dashboard revision against schema major 1 and package limits.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List approved connection aliases. No secrets.

tools.name: describe_connection
tools.description: Describe an approved connection schema and permitted operations. No secrets.

tools.name: inspect_connection
tools.description: Read permitted live data or entities for an approved connection. Reads only. No secrets.

tools.name: preview_dashboard
tools.description: Render an exact dashboard revision on the hidden Screenpunk helper and return PNG image content plus metadata. Live preview — actions control your devices. Preview is live by default. The workbench does not need to be open. Never returns only a local path. Failed captures are errors, not placeholder images.

tools.name: interact_preview
tools.description: Send a bounded tap, input, or scroll to the live preview. Live actions are explicitly described. Capture itself does not click controls.

tools.name: deploy_dashboard
tools.description: Deploy the exact previewed revision the user approved in chat to a paired device over the TLS 1.3 LAN link. Requires revision and approved=true; revisions never previewed by this controller return permission_required. Agent-mediated approval, not a cryptographic guarantee. Idempotent on deploymentId. A failed transfer keeps the device's current dashboard.

tools.name: list_versions
tools.description: List immutable revisions for a dashboard, whether each was previewed, and which devices have it active.

tools.name: rollback_dashboard
tools.description: Redeploy a revision from the device's history through the normal deployment path after the user chose it in chat (approved=true). Requires a paired device.

tools.name: get_deployment
tools.description: Get correlated deployment status by deploymentId: phase, error, and the device's active revision. No silent queued deploy in the alpha.

tools.name: get_logs
tools.description: Return redacted, bounded controller and preview diagnostics. No secrets.

tools.name: get_help
tools.description: Troubleshooting help. Topic unlink explains the five-second two-finger device menu gesture and confirmed Disconnect.
